title: Neo4j Ontology Specification v1
description: Draft JSON Schema for the Ontology spec v1 proposal (2026-09-25 doc state). Nodes and relationships are keyed by local ids; the label/type lives inside the entry. First-party extensions ride extensions_map as named keys, custom extensions carry the fixed envelope under custom; extension payloads are never validated by this schema.

$schema.description: Spec link including the version. Meta-level; doubles as document-type marker.

version.description: The ontology's own version. Identity metadata, not lifecycle.

nodes.description: Map key is a local id, not the label. The label lives in label / labels.identifier, so label renames do not break references.

relationships.description: Map key is a local id; the relationship type lives in the type field. Several keys may share a type across different endpoint pairs, but note graph-type enforcement keys on the type alone and cannot distinguish pairs yet.

propertyType.description: A type object; scalars may use the bare-token shorthand. Element types are always scalars: no nesting. 'any' opts the property out of type constraints (mixed value types).

oneOf.description: Mixed or unknown value types. No graph-type constraint is applied to this property.

constraint.description: Composite constraint objects only (multi-property keys/uniques). Shape provisional, aligned with graph-spec 4.0.0's constraint object.

one_of.description: Allowed values. JSON Schema's word. Default value support.

node.description: A node id from the nodes map.

reference.description: A single informational URI pointing at an external definition of this element (e.g. the original RDF resource).

extension.description: Custom extension envelope, four fields: type required; $schema, name, definition optional. definition is free-form and never validated by this spec. Unknown extra fields are carried untouched.

extensionsMap.description: First-party extensions as named keys (neo4j:*), each shape defined by its owner and not validated by this spec; available in the ontology spec SDK. Custom extensions ride the fixed envelope under the reserved custom key.

node.description: Every node carries its label in label (simple case) or labels.identifier (when implied/optional labels exist). Not schema-enforced; a node with neither is meaningless.

label.description: The node label. Simple case; use labels when implied/optional labels exist.

type.description: The relationship type. One-to-one with the map key in the common case; several keys may share a type across different endpoint pairs.
